name: GMA Accessories Inc.
note: Privately held apparel and fashion accessories company founded by George Altirs in Brooklyn in 1990; owner of the Capelli New York brand and of Capelli Sport, which Altirs launched in 2011 (capellisportplus.com: Capelli Sport is 'under the umbrella of GMA Accessories, Inc.', 'led by owner and CEO, George Altirs'; Sportico, 15 June 2026: 'the company... is still privately held').
